roleContext.jobDescription: The wind turbine fleet analytics service predicts component failures for an operator's turbines and raises work orders for the maintenance crews. The role reports to the head of fleet analytics and works with the platform team, the maintenance planners and the site crews.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Predictive Maintenance Engineer, Wind Turbine Fleet Analytics

## Experience

- Deployed four gearbox and bearing failure models into the live scoring service of the fleet analytics platform over three years, releasing each through the platform team's release pipeline under my own release tickets.
- Watched live alert precision against confirmed failures in the weekly review with the maintenance planners, and handled the production model incidents in that period, including two sensor feed drop-outs, with incident records in the platform incident log.
- Built and backtested each model on the historical sensor and work-order data under the evaluation protocol agreed with the planners before proposing it for release.
- Coordinated model releases with the platform team in the release review, recording in the release ticket which checks were mine and which belonged to the platform team.
- Wrote the model card for each model, listing the training data window, the backtest results, the known limitations for turbines without vibration sensors and the hand-over conditions.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the release tickets for the four models, the weekly precision review for the last quarter and the incident records for the two sensor feed drop-outs, with the platform incident log identifiers as a verification trail.
